name: backend-feishu-stream
about: Private wrapper required: Linux network-none, runtime CA, local Axios absoluteURL/CONNECT proxy and real binary WS. Ordinary enabled Feishu config receives wrong event + reversed fragments + duplicate, drives real model and actual Open API reply. Independent formal WS observer runs builtin bash to await mock reply receipt without sleep. Normal protocol first; does not claim adapter stop cleanup. TS self and actual wrongreply negative required, not yet run. Channel injection additionally waits for the real observer builtin control GET, so observer-initial capture causally precedes channel provider insertion; no arbitrary object sorting.
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
proxy:
  url: http://127.0.0.1:38413
  noProxy: 127.0.0.1,localhost
adapters:
  feishu:
    enabled: true
    appId: cli_0123456789abcdef
    appSecret: feishu-local-secret
    connectionMode: stream
